title: Water Cycle comparison clarity
method: Frozen actual runtime in owned ephemeral localhost server and isolated Chromium. Native comparison, claim and disclosure controls; exact rendered readings, card geometry, scoped accessibility, focus handoffs and learner-work preservation. No learner tabs, port8770, runtime edits or Git writes.
